typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CALLLISTMASTER_IID as long,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_BIRTH_DT as string,
		AGE as integer,
		MEMBER_GENDER_CD as string,
		PHONE1 as string,
		UNIT_JOB as string,
		CALLLIST_DT as string,
		MEMBER_ADDRESS_ATTENTION_LINE as string,
		MEMBER_ADDRESS_ADDRESS1 as string,
		MEMBER_ADDRESS_CITY_NM as string,
		MEMBER_ADDRESS_STATE_CD as string,
		MEMBER_ADDRESS_ZIP as string,
		PHONE1_SRC as string,
		PHONE2 as string,
		PHONE2_SRC as string,
		Plan as string,
		Prog as string,
		DEPENDENTS1 as string,
		DEPENDENTS2 as string,
		DEPENDENTS3 as string,
		DEPENDENTS4 as string,
		PCP_NAME as string,
		PCP_ID as string,
		CALLLIST_ID as string,
		CALLLISTGRP_ID as string,
		OB_NAME as string,
		LOAD_DT as string,
		AUTO_ASSIGN as string,
		ATTEMPTS as integer,
		COMMENT4 as string,
		APP_DATE as string,
		FILLER_FIELD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'exec PR_PDS_GET_CALLLIST_DATA @P_CALLLISTDATE_IID=? with result sets (   (     CALLLISTMASTER_IID bigint,     LOAD_DT varchar(10),     CALLLIST_DT varchar(10),     MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER varchar(30),     MEMBER_FIRST_NAME varchar(35),     MEMBER_LAST_NAME varchar(35),     MEMBER_BIRTH_DT varchar(10),     AGE int,     MEMBER_ADDRESS_ATTENTION_LINE varchar(35),     MEMBER_ADDRESS_ADDRESS1 varchar(40),     MEMBER_ADDRESS_CITY_NM varchar(100),     MEMBER_ADDRESS_STATE_CD varchar(5),     MEMBER_ADDRESS_ZIP varchar(9),     MEMBER_GENDER_CD varchar(1),     DEPENDENTS1 varchar(66),     DEPENDENTS2 varchar(66),     DEPENDENTS3 varchar(66),     DEPENDENTS4 varchar(66),     PHONE1 varchar(10),     PHONE1_SRC varchar(10),     PHONE2 varchar(10),     PHONE2_SRC varchar(10),     [Plan] varchar(10),     Prog varchar(15),     COMMENT4 varchar(30),     PCP_NAME varchar(70),     OB_NAME varchar(35),     PCP_ID varchar(20),     UNIT_JOB varchar(20),     CALLLIST_ID varchar(3),     CALLLISTGRP_ID varchar(3),     AUTO_ASSIGN varchar(1),     ATTEMPTS int,     APP_DATE varchar(10),     FILLER_FIELD varchar(100)   ) );',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> CallListProc
CallListProc derive(CALLLISTMASTER_IID = CALLLISTMASTER_IID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		Zip as string,
		LoadDate as string,
		Phone1_Source as string,
		Phone2_Source as string,
		CallListId as string,
		Gender as string,
		FileDate as string,
		AppDate as string,
		Phone1 as string,
		Phone2 as string,
		Dependents4 as string,
		Attempts as string,
		DOB as string,
		CallListMaster_IID as string,
		Street as string,
		Prog as string,
		UnitJob as string,
		Age as string,
		AutoAssign as string,
		FillerField as string,
		FirstName as string,
		Comment4 as string,
		Dependents1 as string,
		Dependents3 as string,
		City as string,
		Dependents2 as string,
		OBName as string,
		CO as string,
		Plan as string,
		CallListGroupId as string,
		State as string,
		MemberKey as string,
		LastName as string,
		PCPName as string,
		PCPId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Zip = MEMBER_ADDRESS_ZIP,
		LoadDate = LOAD_DT,
		Phone1_Source = PHONE1_SRC,
		Phone2_Source = PHONE2_SRC,
		CallListId = CALLLIST_ID,
		Gender = MEMBER_GENDER_CD,
		FileDate = CALLLIST_DT,
		AppDate = APP_DATE,
		Phone1 = PHONE1,
		Phone2 = PHONE2,
		Dependents4 = DEPENDENTS4,
		Attempts = ATTEMPTS,
		DOB = MEMBER_BIRTH_DT,
		CallListMaster_IID = CALLLISTMASTER_IID,
		Street = MEMBER_ADDRESS_ADDRESS1,
		Prog,
		UnitJob = UNIT_JOB,
		Age = AGE,
		AutoAssign = AUTO_ASSIGN,
		FillerField = FILLER_FIELD,
		FirstName = MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,
		Comment4 = COMMENT4,
		Dependents1 = DEPENDENTS1,
		Dependents3 = DEPENDENTS3,
		City = MEMBER_ADDRESS_CITY_NM,
		Dependents2 = DEPENDENTS2,
		OBName = OB_NAME,
		CO = MEMBER_ADDRESS_ATTENTION_LINE,
		Plan,
		CallListGroupId = CALLLISTGRP_ID,
		State = MEMBER_ADDRESS_STATE_CD,
		MemberKey = MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,
		LastName = MEMBER_LAST_NAME,
		PCPName = PCP_NAME,
		PCPId = PCP_ID)) ~> CallListFlatFile
PlaceHolderRowCount derive({Convert.LOAD_DT} = toString(LOAD_DT),
		{Convert.Dependents1} = toString(DEPENDENTS1),
		{Convert.Phone2_SRC} = toString(PHONE2_SRC),
		{Convert.PCP_NAME} = toString(PCP_NAME),
		{Convert.Dependents4} = toString(DEPENDENTS4),
		{Convert.ZIP} = toString(MEMBER_ADDRESS_ZIP),
		{Convert.FILLER_FIELD} = toString(FILLER_FIELD),
		{Convert.File_Date} = toString(CALLLIST_DT),
		{Convert.Prog} = toString(Prog),
		{Convert.Phone1_SRC} = toString(PHONE1_SRC),
		{Convert.CO} = toString(MEMBER_ADDRESS_ATTENTION_LINE),
		{Convert.CALLLISTGRP_ID} = toString(CALLLISTGRP_ID),
		{Convert.LastName} = toString(MEMBER_LAST_NAME),
		{Convert.GENDER} = toString(MEMBER_GENDER_CD),
		{Convert.Dependents3} = toString(DEPENDENTS3),
		{Convert.COMMENT4} = toString(COMMENT4),
		{Convert.OB_NAME} = toString(OB_NAME),
		{Convert.SRC_SYS_MEMBER_KEY} = toString(MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER),
		{Convert.AutoAssign} = toString(AUTO_ASSIGN),
		{Convert.DOB} = toString(MEMBER_BIRTH_DT),
		{Convert.CALLLIST_ID} = toString(CALLLIST_ID),
		{Convert.Plan} = toString(Plan),
		{Convert.PHONE2} = toString(PHONE2),
		{Convert.FirstName} = toString(MEMBER_FIRST_NAME),
		{Convert.STREET} = toString(MEMBER_ADDRESS_ADDRESS1),
		{Convert.PCP_ID} = toString(PCP_ID),
		{Convert.Dependents2} = toString(DEPENDENTS2),
		{Convert.PHONE1} = toString(PHONE1),
		{Convert.CITY} = toString(MEMBER_ADDRESS_CITY_NM),
		{Convert.UnitJob} = toString(UNIT_JOB),
		{Convert.Attempts} = toString(ATTEMPTS),
		{Convert.APP_DATE} = toString(APP_DATE),
		{Convert.ST} = toString(MEMBER_ADDRESS_STATE_CD)) ~> DataConversion
